title:
A Human EEG
Dataset for Multisensory Perception and Mental
Imagery
description: The YOTO (You Only Think Once) dataset is a human EEG resource for studying multisensory perception and mental imagery. Twenty participants completed tasks with unimodal and multimodal (visual, auditory, and combined) cues while EEG was recorded at 1000 Hz, and they gave self-reported vividness ratings of their imagery. Technical validation with event-related potentials and power spectral density analyses confirmed data reliability and distinct neural responses across stimuli, supporting research on neural decoding, perception, and cognitive modeling.
methods_description: EEG was recorded at a 1000 Hz sampling rate from 20 participants performing tasks with visual, auditory, and combined visual-auditory cues. Participants gave self-reported vividness ratings. Data quality was validated with ERP and power spectral density analyses.
